provenance.validation: El usuario confirmó los tres puntos en el dashboard real.

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS minute,
  JSON_VALUE(json_payload.category) AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS requests,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNTIF(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status_code) AS INT64)
      BETWEEN 400 AND 499),
    COUNT(*)
  ) AS client_error_rate
FROM `adfasdfasfd-1899a.global._Default._Default`
WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-31T02:07:27.947662Z')
  AND timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2026-10-31T02:07:35.148179Z')
  AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.run_id) = 'smoke-20261031T020723Z'
  AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.phase) = 'traffic'
  AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message) = 'request_completed'
GROUP BY minute, category
ORDER BY minute, category
